text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You and your trainer seem to be getting
along
quite well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Okay? Any reason you're bringing this
up?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was watching my subje—the hard-working
students the other day as
part of my research on the connection
between nutrient intake and physique,
and I spotted the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer must be something special
to keep
up with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I have no idea what you're talkin' about.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant. Hey! What was my time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I also let Air Shakur know that I've
attached a
schedule for tomorrow based
on her training
performance today.
choice_data_list: I sent it to your computer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling good today. I think I can go
another
few laps.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: If your times fall below the bench...
If your times fall below the bench...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer must be something special
to keep
up with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Well, it beats getting in my way.)
